title: pysmi JSON OID index, schema version 1
description: The document JsonCodeGen.gen_index() emits for a set of compiled modules: the OID-to-module reverse index. Every section maps a dotted-decimal OID to the modules that claim it. A list rather than a single name because more than one module can claim the same OID, and the index records that rather than choosing. See docs/source/jsondoc-schema.rst.

enterprise.description: Enterprise OID, where the module declares one under 1.3.6.1.4.1.

oids.description: Prefix-compressed object OIDs: an OID is omitted when a shorter prefix already present maps to a module set that is a superset of its own. This is what keeps the index proportional to the number of subtrees rather than to the number of nodes.

additionalProperties.description: Module names claiming this OID, sorted and deduplicated.

schema.description: Rewritten on every merge, so an index carries the version of the run that last wrote it rather than the version it was first built under.
